worldGeneration: Released historyWorld/day progression from 1930 to each starting year; identical pre-takeover World JSON reused for both variants.
metrics: season cash flow (closingCash minus openingBoundaryCash) / turnover, when currencies match
paid and free arrivals; mean and median paid fee
comparison: Paired cases; report each era and case, and their unweighted season-ratio means. Never sum nominal amounts across currencies or eras.
claimRule: Claim improved cash accumulation only if the modern cases' mean cash-flow/turnover falls and no additional sampled career ends in bankruptcy. Report worsened individual cases and historical cases separately. Increasing paid fees or purchases alone is insufficient.
scopeLimit: One seed, two countries and five seasons are mechanism observations, not ECON-29's 50-season career gate or proof of worldwide real-football balance.
finalGate: Independent review of exact submissions, then coordinator verify:batch on the combined integrated source.
budget: One 60-minute cycle from 2026-11-09T01:50Z. Reserve final-gate and review time; do not conceal timeouts or failed attempts.
